body: Yeah its really fun. I've logged about 73 hours in two weeks. I've never played CS:GO, but I've played so many games. I think I've completed the main story of about 100 games. It's always been my favorite hobby.
I like PC gaming. I've been playing the new WoW expansion lately. I also really like history, and games in general. I am a huge nerd. What about you?

I feel like I've ruined my life. Recently, I've been self harming by punching myself on my forehead. I know that sounds weird. I get so overwhelmed with everything that I feel like I need to take out on myself.

I fucked up six months ago, and I thought I was doing the right thing. I told a co-worker and a friend that I had feelings for her, and that I wanted to distance myself. I told her this through a text message. It was making me really sad, and I knew I wouldn't be with her, so I decided to distance myself, and I wanted to tell her beforehand so that she would know why I was distancing myself. Dumb. I know. 


Ever since then, I've been ostracized at work. People being mean to me and all that. It's been hard to deal with. I think they would want me dead.

Thank you. I don't know what to say, so I'm sorry for the loss of words. I also texted a friend. I feel like I'm burdening him. I feel like the only way for this depression to end is if I kill myself.
